questions.instructions: Which action fits this paper position and the strategy rules? Use frozen account facts and configured order_size. A bullish SMA crossover supports buy if affordable; a bearish crossover supports reducing/exiting. Hold requires shares; wait requires no shares. Propose only, never execute.

questions.instructions: At the selected candle cutoff, is an upward crossover, downward crossover, or no crossover visible in the PNG? Judge the image, not the supplied Python signal. If the lines/cutoff cannot be read, answer unreadable. Equal averages retain the last known side; only a change of side confirms a crossover.
questions.name: crossover

questions.instructions: Is the visible chart sufficient to assess the signal at the cutoff? Require identifiable cutoff, both SMA lines and enough preceding context to establish a change of side. The first comparable pair alone is not a crossover.
